title: personal-okr-weekly-checkin-marco-silva-2026-04-23
content:
Week: 2026-04-20 to 2026-04-24
Owner: Marco Silva (eng-serving-runtime)
Summary:
- Quick personal check-in for OKRs/KPIs. Keeping this informal - notes to self + action list.
- Overall: decent progress on batching improvements, but still lagging on automated regression tests for quantized paths.

Objectives / Key Results (current quarter) - status snapshot:
1) Reduce average p95 generation latency for chat-live route by 15% (baseline: 420ms) - current: 390ms (~7% improvement)
   - Progress: micro-batching changes landed on canary (PR 678). Measurement pipeline shows p95 drop to ~390ms on canary cluster.
   - Blockers: rollout needs more perf runs at longer sequences; KV cache warmup inconsistent under synthetic workload.

2) Lower per-token inference cost by 12% for high-throughput workloads - current estimate: 8%
   - Progress: quantization profile v2 reduces memory pressure; throughput improvements in batching kernel. Need to validate output quality on eval set.
   - Blockers: quality regression detected on 2.3% of eval prompts (see INF-3421).

3) Deliver infra for canary A/B rollout (observability + automatic rollback) - on track 
   - Progress: rollout hooks implemented in console; tracing payloads hooked to per-request IDs. Canary->stable promotion still manual.

Weekly accomplishments (this week):
- Landed continuous batching change (merged, PR 678). Verified basic perf on canary.
- Built lightweight KV cache warmup script to reduce cold-start variance (WIP).
- Wrote preliminary evals to compare quantized-v2 vs float32 across 500 prompt set. Found regressions concentrated in factuality for long-form Q/A.
- Pair session with Hunter to instrument detailed latency breakdown per kernel (helpful).

Open issues / blockers:
- Eval regressions for quantized-v2: need to dig into attention rounding differences. Marked INF-3421. Action: allocate 1 day to root cause (next Tues).
- KV cache warmup still flaky under high-concurrency synthetic workload - possible race in cache population. Action: add more logging + reproduce reliably in staging.
- No automated nightly run for the new eval suite - currently manual; needs CI job.

Next week plan / action items (priority):
- A1: Root-cause INF-3421 regressions (owner: Marco) - block until validated.
- A2: Add nightly CI job for quantized-v2 eval (owner: Avery Chen + Marco) - aim end of next week.
- A3: Harden KV warmup script and run scale test in staging (owner: Hunter) - include telemetry for cache hit ratio.
- A4: Run 50k token long-seq perf runs on canary to measure tail behavior (owner: Marco).

Personal development / goals this sprint:
- Spend 2x pairing hours on tooling (observability + tracing) to get better at signal interpretation.
- Learn more about quantization numerical behavior - allocate 3 hours of deep reading + experiments next Wed.

Retro / quick reflections:
- What went well: landed a meaningful perf PR quickly; collaboration with Hunter was effective and unblocked instrumentation.
- What could be better: my PRs lack enough regression tests - need to bake tests earlier.
- Experiment for next sprint: try a small canary with automatic fallback to float32 when eval delta > threshold.

Notes to self (scratchpad):
- Jira: INF-3421 has test cases and failing examples. Add a minimal reproducer to the ticket.
- Link to eval results: /shared/efs/evals/quant-v2/2026-04-22/results.csv (add to confluence summary)
- Slack snippet: posted quick summary in #eng-serving-runtime - collect comments from SRE for staging behavior.

Quick TODO checklist (short):
- [ ] Add nightly eval CI job (Avery + Marco)
- [ ] Reproducer for INF-3421 (Marco)
- [ ] Harden KV warmup and add logs (Hunter)
- [ ] Run long-seq tail perf runs on canary (Marco)

Questions for manager / sync topics:
- Safe to run canary long-seq 50k token run overnight on dedicated canary cluster? Need SRE sign-off.
- If quant-v2 regression persists, do we revert rollout or ship a targeted fix + partial rollback?

End notes: keep this doc informal. Transfer key outcomes to confluence page after next week when we have a clearer signal.

----
Revision history:
- 2026-04-23: initial draft (post-merge verification notes)
- 2026-04-24: added CI TODOs + updated perf numbers after additional canary runs
